heading: Enforcement of forfeitures
lead: When an offense by a seaman also is a criminal violation, it is not necessary that a criminal proceeding be brought to enforce a forfeiture.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes Revised sectionSource section (U.S. Code) 1150446:705 Section 11504 provides that when a seaman has committed a criminal offense, a forfeiture may be enforced through civil proceedings.
